name: Incentive for the Intra Caste Marriage within Scheduled Caste Community
benefit: **Incentive Amount:** - ₹2,00,000/- if an SC/ST boy or girl marries a person from a different SC/ST sub-caste. - ₹1,50,000/- if the couple has availed of the simple marriage grant. **Subsidy Disbursement:** The incentive is provided in two installments: - 50% in cash. - 50% as a fixed deposit with a minimum term of 3 years.
_eligibility_text:
1. The couple should belong to different sub caste of SC.
   1. The bride and groom should be residing in Karnataka. 
   1. The family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-.
   1. The age of the bride should be between 18 to 42 years at the time of marriage.
   1. The age of the groom should be between 21 to 45 years at the time of marriage.
